question: Which of the following equations is correct for one mole of gas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**V1/V2 = T1/T2 (at constant pressure)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Charles’s law:

It allows to set up the relationship between the changes in volume and temperature under constant pressure-

 
• V1/V₂ = T₁/T2<
